# Stormcast protocol test vectors (docs/PROTOCOL.md).
# The server's Java tests must encode exactly these bytes, and the app's Rust tests must decode them.
# Format: name | hex. Spaces in the hex are ignored.
preamble    | 5354524d 01
hello       | 01000000 537b2264 65766963 65223a22 4c656e6f 766f2054 42333131 4655222c 22636f64 6563223a 22683236 34222c22 73657276 6572223a 22302e31 2e30222c 22616e64 726f6964 223a2231 36222c22 73646b22 3a33367d
session     | 02000000 09000004 b0000007 8001
config      | 03000000 14000000 01676400 2aac2b40 3c000000 0168ee3c 80
frame_key   | 04000000 0f010000 00000012 d6870000 00016588
frame_delta | 04000000 0f000000 00000013 17a20000 0001419a
error       | 05000000 457b2263 6f646522 3a22656e 636f6465 725f6661 696c6564 222c226d 65737361 6765223a 224e6f20 482e3236 3420656e 636f6465 725c6e5c 2271756f 7465645c 2220c3a9 227d
